acceptance: The Documentation workflow linkcheck job passes on develop
The blog index links either point at pages Sphinx builds or are excluded with a documented reason
context:
Found while checking documentation outcomes after the live-cloud corpus merges. None of those merges touched the blog. The Astro migration items (astro-site-33-blog-collection-and-feed, astro-site-54-retire-sphinx-and-legacy-site) may make the links obsolete, but the Sphinx linkcheck is red until then.

Closed 2026-10-09 (tracker review against develop 34de720b8): docs/blog/index.rst no longer exists, because the blog index moved in #2597. The three links are excluded with a stated reason in docs/linkcheck_ignore.txt:69-76 (#2717). Linkcheck passed in the last 8 develop Documentation runs (37976115475 to 37995649912). The codespell failures in the same runs were Docker Hub rate limits, tracked in ci-docker-hub-unauthenticated-pulls-20261009.
description:
The Documentation workflow's linkcheck job fails on every recent develop run with the same three broken links in `docs/blog/index.rst`: `archive.html`, `tag.html` and `author.html`. These are relative `.html` targets that Sphinx does not build. Build, spellcheck, example validation and visual checks pass, so the red runs hide any new docs failure.

Seen in runs 37138879947 (`3428753dc`), 37163832053 (`c373a1a54`), 37163873730 (`7a3dc8355`) and 37202138826 (`058f664da`), and in every run checked between them. The links sit at lines 25-27, or 28-30 after #2597 edited the file.
